from pathlib import Path

programs=wd/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-e4df7867.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Recolor solid full-width and full-height separator lines to 2."""
    out = [list(row) for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(out[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({out[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
